spin_transfer.equations: 21-26; first incoming parton polarized, observed outgoing parton defines t

early_hard_factors.equations: 3; the earlier Collins convention and angular phase must be converted together

legacy_code.role: Reduced hard/flavor expressions only; its Gaussian transverse dependence is a different model. No pickle deserialization or upstream imports.

FeynFacet.role: Pinned plain Born coefficient expressions are reference evidence. Native WSL readiness is NOT_READY (Wolfram not found); no fresh FeynCalc/FORM/Tracer derivation is claimed. Inclusive NLO transfer is not a finite-R jet observable.

hard_convention.theory: SU(3), massless on-shell 2-to-2 scattering, tree hard factors, unpolarized initial spin/color averages
hard_convention.invariants: s=(p_a+p_b)^2>0, t=(p_a-p_c)^2<0, u=(p_b-p_c)^2<0, s+t+u=0; c is the tagged observed parton
hard_convention.UU: d sigma/dt = pi*alpha_s^2/s^2 * H_U; H_U=4*s/alpha_s^2 * (d sigma/dOmega)_PDG
hard_convention.UT: H_T = T_abc_CHL * H_U, with the outgoing spin difference at fixed incoming transverse spin. No extra factor2 or lepton DNN.
hard_convention.identical_final_particles: One tagged observed-parton channel; no additional 1/2 or duplicated identical observed channel. Distinct observed species are separate entries.
hard_convention.zero_transfer: Incoming gluon, observed gluon, or observed different quark flavor. Charge-conjugate channels use identical hard factors.

flavor_contract.basis: Explicit distinct PDG IDs:21 and complete signed quark/antiquark pairs with abs(pid)=1..5. Order is caller-declared and retained as an immutable tuple.
flavor_contract.interpretation: quark_only omits outgoing gluon fragmentation, not incoming gluons. quark_and_gluon is the Born algebra extension; a physical gluon TMD is not supplied here.
flavor_contract.heavy: All declared hard flavors are massless; heavy-flavor support is not a heavy-mass matching or experimental admission certificate.
flavor_contract.inputs: fA/fB are unweighted collinear f1 at x_a/x_b. D is the supplied TMD D1. hA is unweighted collinear h1. C already includes jperp/(z*M_h)*H1perp in the Trento convention. Do not use x*f arrays without their declared conversion.
flavor_contract.input_dimensions: Flavor vectors for a point; flavor-by-node matrices for supplied-node integration. Algebraic contractions permit signed renormalized responses; a physical asymmetry requires positive total F_UU. No clipping.

kinematics_and_measure.x_b: -x_a*T/(x_a*S+U); quadrature nodes must lie strictly inside x_a_min<x_a<1 and0<x_b<1
kinematics_and_measure.common_prefactor: alpha_s^2/[S*x_a*x_b*(x_a*S+U)], multiplying each supplied-node UU and UT contraction before integration
kinematics_and_measure.measure: Explicit nonnegative supplied quadrature/Jacobian/acceptance weights with a nonempty source descriptor. Include the declared jet and jperp coordinate measures; e.g. d^2pT=2*pi*pT*dpT after full jet-azimuth integration.
kinematics_and_measure.ratio: Sum weighted polarized cross sections and unpolarized yields separately, then divide. A common normalization at fixed pT need not cancel through pT integration.
kinematics_and_measure.published_baseline: STAR17 uses reported mean pT/jperp and an eta integral at200/500GeV, Q=mu=pT, with quark TMD fragmentation. It is not a new510GeV data or acceptance prescription.

Collins_bridge.opposite_phase: sin(phiH-phiS) changes the signed amplitude once
Collins_bridge.moment: The STAR J1 Fourier moment is M_h*H1perp(1)=-Hhat3/(2*z), using the KPSY initial contract. It is not the dimensionless Trento first moment.
Collins_bridge.gaussian_identity: For H1perp=2*z^2*M_h^2*H1perp(1)*exp(-jperp^2/w)/(pi*w^2), C=-Hhat3*jperp*exp(-jperp^2/w)/(pi*w^2). Its full d^2jperp integral is -sqrt(pi)*Hhat3/(2*sqrt(w)).
Collins_bridge.zero: Differential jperp=0 gives C=0; it must not select the integrated moment. No jperp sentinel is used by this interface.

validation_policy.integration_reference: Independent recoil-rapidity integral using x_a=(pT/sqrt_s)*(exp(eta)+exp(y_d)), x_b=(pT/sqrt_s)*(exp(-eta)+exp(-y_d)), and measure alpha_s^2/(S^2*x_a*x_b) dy_d. Integrate UU and UT separately with adaptive rtol=atol=1e-13 and require both estimated relative errors below algebra_max_scaled. Compare yields normalized by S^2/alpha_s^2 before applying the relative floor; retain all coarse orders and require the declared final order.
validation_policy.derivative_reference: Interior synthetic KPSY initial-family point (Nhd=-0.91, beta_u=0.4, beta_d=0.7; other coordinates from the rounded published point); full 13-column gradients and directional HVP against 256-bit fourth-order central finite differences of independent pinned legacy contractions. This is not a boundary derivative check. Shared analytic initial functions are explicitly not independent evolution evidence. Both finite-difference steps must pass.
validation_policy.source_arithmetic: Interpret literal arithmetic in pinned expressions as exact rationals for algebra checks; this is not execution of the original Python Float64 program or Wolfram code.
validation_policy.scope: Exact-rational and independent PDG/CHL channel checks; all flavor routing, common prefactors, supplied-node ratio algebra and separately labeled synthetic response/Gaussian normalization controls. These do not certify full evolved STAR predictions, measured acceptance or production throughput/coverage.
